entries.title: Psalms 132:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of Ascents.>> LORD, remember David [And] all his afflictions;

entries.title: Psalms 132:2
segments: How he swore to the LORD, [And] vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

entries.title: Psalms 132:3
segments: "Surely I will not go into the chamber of my house, Or go up to the comfort of my bed;

entries.title: Psalms 132:4
segments: I will not give sleep to my eyes [Or] slumber to my eyelids,

entries.title: Psalms 132:5
segments: Until I find a place for the LORD, A dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob."

entries.title: Psalms 132:6
segments: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah; We found it in the fields of the woods.

entries.title: Psalms 132:7
segments: Let us go into His tabernacle; Let us worship at His footstool.

entries.title: Psalms 132:8
segments: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.

entries.title: Psalms 132:9
segments: Let Your priests be clothed with righteousness, And let Your saints shout for joy.

entries.title: Psalms 132:10
segments: For Your servant David's sake, Do not turn away the face of Your Anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 132:11
segments: ¶The LORD has sworn [in] truth to David; He will not turn from it: "I will set upon your throne the fruit of your body.

entries.title: Psalms 132:12
segments: If your sons will keep My covenant And My testimony which I shall teach them, Their sons also shall sit upon your throne forevermore."

entries.title: Psalms 132:13
segments: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired [it] for His dwelling place:

entries.title: Psalms 132:14
segments: "This [is] My resting place forever; Here I will dwell, for I have desired it.

entries.title: Psalms 132:15
segments: I will abundantly bless her provision; I will satisfy her poor with bread.

entries.title: Psalms 132:16
segments: I will also clothe her priests with salvation, And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

entries.title: Psalms 132:17
segments: There I will make the horn of David grow; I will prepare a lamp for My Anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 132:18
segments: His enemies I will clothe with shame, But upon Himself His crown shall flourish."
